verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no account-wide or bulk data export, no export of agents or workflows in an open format, and no offboarding path. The closest items are adjacent features rather than this capability: downloading individual agent-generated artifacts, syncing organization skills with GitHub, and API/SDK primitives that a developer could use to build an export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
